verses.text: A Song of the Ascents. In YHWH turning back the captivity of Zion, we were like those dreaming.

segments.text: A Song of the Ascents. In YHWH turning back the captivity of Zion, we were like those dreaming.

verses.text: Then our mouth was filled with laughter, and our tongue with a shout of joy. Then they said among the nations, “YHWH, has done great things for these.”

segments.text: Then our mouth was filled with laughter, and our tongue with a shout of joy. Then they said among the nations, “YHWH, has done great things for these.”

verses.text: YHWH has done great things for us; and we came to be glad.

segments.text: YHWH has done great things for us; and we came to be glad.

verses.text: Bring back, O YHWH, our captives, like streams in the Negev!

segments.text: Bring back, O YHWH, our captives, like streams in the Negev!

verses.text: Those sowing in tears will reap with a shout of joy.

segments.text: Those sowing in tears will reap with a shout of joy.

verses.text: Going forth, he who goes and weeps, bearing the basket of seed, coming in, he comes with a shout, bearing his sheaves.
